title: pterostylis extranea
intro: Pterostylis extranea, commonly known as the greenhood orchid, is a species of terrestrial orchid native to Australia. It is reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential therapeutic actions such as wound healing and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents of Pterostylis extranea include phenolic compounds and flavonoids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential applications of this plant.
